title: Recovery Insights
content: Today was tough. I found myself feeling frustrated with some of the patients. I know it's not right, but I can't help but feel a certain bias against those who just don't seem to try. I need to work on this.

title: Group Therapy Schedule
content: Upcoming group therapy sessions are scheduled for March 1st, 3rd, and 5th. We will be introducing new techniques focused on mindfulness and coping strategies.

title: Therapy Technique Notes
content: We should consider integrating more cognitive-behavioral exercises into our sessions. Also, exploring the possibility of guest speakers who have successfully overcome addiction could be inspiring.
